info.title: Sanctity bounded repository API
info.description: API credentials authenticate stable principals. Current catalog authority controls every operation. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store. JSON requests: at most 4 MiB, depth 32 and 20,000 nodes; queries: depth 16 and 256 nodes. JSON must be UTF-8 and have no duplicate or unrecognized fields. No browser login, remote filesystem access, raw blob access, arbitrary draft submission or credential administration endpoints.

servers.description: Loopback origin; external access requires a TLS reverse proxy.
